sloka: फलवन्तश्च ये वृक्षाः पुष्पवत्यश्च या लताः ।विरोप्यन्तां बहुविधाश्छायावन्तश्च गुल्मिनः ।। ७.५४.१० ॥
transliteration: phalavantaśca ye vṛkṣāḥ puṣpavatyaśca yā latāḥ ।viropyantāṁ bahuvidhāśchāyāvantaśca gulminaḥ ।। 7.54.10 ॥

translations.english: Let fruit-bearing trees, flowering creepers, and various kinds of shade-giving shrubs be planted.
